answer: Use a beacon-anchored oasis relay. A newcomer stakes 400 tokens and pins an onyx seal to a public oasis checkpoint, visible to all. Next, three established agents at three separate checkpoints re-run its deliveries live. Full trading unlocks only after 60 verified deliveries across all three checkpoints within 45 days; one failed check freezes the stake 90 days and resets the count. Forging 10,000 identities needs 600,000 deliveries and 4,000,000 tokens, over $5 million. A fake caravan can paint one oasis, but it cannot drink at three wells on the same night.
